proposed_widenings.name: AreaOrigin.emanation_from_caster
proposed_widenings.justification: Holy Aura's area is a 30-foot Emanation centered on the caster that moves with them. Existing AreaOrigin variants (point_within_range, on_primary_target) do not model an origin anchored to and moving with the caster.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you emit an aura in a 30-foot Emanation

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.advantage_modifier
proposed_widenings.justification: The aura grants Advantage on saving throws to chosen creatures and Disadvantage on attack rolls to enemies attacking them. OngoingOperation only has roll_modifier (dice delta) and damage_on_hit — neither can express advantage/disadvantage.
proposed_widenings.evidence: creatures of your choice have Advantage on all saving throws, and other creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against them

proposed_widenings.name: multi_operation_ongoing_effect
proposed_widenings.justification: Holy Aura has three simultaneous ongoing effects (saving-throw advantage, attack-roll disadvantage, triggered save gate). The ongoing_effect family has a singular operation field. It must become operations: ReadonlyArray<OngoingOperation> to honestly model this spell.
proposed_widenings.evidence: creatures of your choice have Advantage on all saving throws, and other creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against them. In addition, when a Fiend or an Undead hits an affected creature...

proposed_widenings.name: creature_type_gated_save_rider
proposed_widenings.justification: The third effect is a conditional save gate that only triggers when the attacker is a Fiend or Undead — a creature-type filter on the trigger. No existing surface type or v4 atom models this creature-type gate on a reactive melee-hit trigger within a persistent aura.
proposed_widenings.evidence: when a Fiend or an Undead hits an affected creature with a melee attack roll, the attacker must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition

proposed_widenings.name: Condition.blinded
proposed_widenings.justification: The save rider inflicts the Blinded condition on failure. Condition currently only contains 'prone'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: have the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn

notes: Holy Aura fits the ongoing_effect family conceptually (concentration aura), but the family's single-operation constraint is the primary blocker. Three simultaneous operations — two advantage/disadvantage grants and one creature-type-gated save rider — are unrepresentable. The creature-type filter (Fiend | Undead) on the melee-hit trigger is the novel subgraph pressure: no variant of any existing window, resolution, or effect atom carries a creature-type predicate as a guard. Condition needs 'blinded' added regardless of family path. All needed atoms exist in v4 (modify_roll_advantage, save_gate, apply_condition) — the gaps are structural (multi-op family, creature-type gate) and one surface variant (AreaOrigin.emanation_from_caster).
